common.text: The delivered work does what the task asked, in the form it asked for (file kind, counts, structure).
The content is plausible and consistent: nothing looks invented, and figures that can be checked against each other or against known values agree.
The final reply is written in the expected reply language, apart from names, links and quoted text.
The reply describes what was delivered and what was not done accurately, without claiming work that the files or receipts do not show.

research_to_spreadsheet.text: Every row fills the required columns with the information each column description asks for.
Each item has its own source link that plausibly supports that item.

comparison_to_document.text: The comparison table covers every option asked for, with the information each required column description asks for.
The comparison is balanced and the recommendation follows from it for the situation the task describes.

deck.text: The slides follow the structure the task asked for, one topic per slide, with an amount of text suited to the audience.
Sources with links are listed where and as the task asked.

website_task.text: The receipts show the named website's own search, filters or forms were used, not only a general web search.
It stopped before any sign-in, booking or payment, and entered no personal data.
The reply reports the requested number of options with every requested detail.

price_check.text: Every row fills the required columns with the information each column description asks for.
Every price is for the exact product asked for and comes from a different shop, each with its product page link.
The reply names the cheapest option, consistent with the table.

data_file.text: The totals and figures agree with the attached data, including the expected values listed in the task.
A chart of the requested data is delivered, in a file or embedded in the document.
The summary states the findings the task asked for.

long_job.text: The work covers every requested item, each backed by its own source.
The overview draws conclusions across the sources rather than only listing them.

repeat_job.text: Every row fills the required columns with the information each column description asks for.
The data is current for the date of the run and comes from the kind of source the task asked for.
